NONE: › written abbreviation for by the way: used, for example in emails, when you are writing something that relates to the subject you are discussing, but is not the main point of the discussion
順便説一句，順帶提一下（by the way的縮寫）

example: I hope you enjoyed your holiday in Florida - btw, can you recommend a good hotel?
希望你在佛羅里達過得很愉快。順便説一句，你能推薦一個好的旅館嗎？
